title: Run the c00 audit's kd=0 arms (eating kept, no digestion product) on fresh seeds 61, 62
summary: From t=6000 states of the unchanged c52 world at 128^2, run 3000 t arms with 3 targets each: fed twin, kd=0 in a disk following each target, kd=0 everywhere, kd=0 plus chiF=0 in the disk. Decides whether the predator's persistence needs its own digestion product at fed prey size.
